Text/Release/DialogAlertsLabels.csv.Network.Disconnect.Explainer.Body_NS1:
Online and offline games work differently in Minecraft Dungeons 2.

Online games are now hosted by a server, not the player.

To keep your game progress safe, and ensure fairness for all players, heroes cannot be switched once created.

Both ways are fun, just different ways to play.

When you have both a Nintendo Switch Online membership and internet connection, your online saves will be ready for you to jump back into.

You can create an offline game at any time to play solo or with friends locally.

Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_enchantsmith_overview_description_: <emphasis>Storm Generators</> spawn powerful enemies and reward those who defeat them
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_town_revival_overview_description:
After you have been downed, you will be teleported to Brave Haven. 

When you want to go back, interact with the Ender pearl statue. 

You can adjust your challenge level by changing the difficulty in settings.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_combat_description: All good heroes need exceptional combat skills. Learn them here.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_artifacts_description:
Artifacts are powerful items that give unique abilities when equipped. You can have a maximum of three artifacts equipped, and you use them by pressing <input id="artifact1"/>, <input id="artifact2"/>, or <input id="artifact3"/>. 

Using an artifact costs souls and many artifacts have cooldown periods between uses. 

Different artifacts works in different ways, some are one-shot that trigger directly, some are channelling continuously and some charge for a big effect at the end. Use them wisely!
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_minecartstations_description:
At minecart stations you will be able to fast travel to fixed places in the world. 

Finding a new minecart station in the world unlocks traveling to that location.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_blacksmith_description:
At the Blacksmith you can upgrade the item level of your equipment to your current character level for emeralds, and re-roll effects on your equipment in exchange for Echo Shards. 

At level 1, you can re-roll effects on Rare items. 

By leveling up the Blacksmith to level 2 using Echo Shards, you unlock the ability to re-roll effects on Special Items. 

Leveling up the Blacksmith to level 3 allows you to re-roll effects on Unique Items.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_enchantsmith_description:
At the Enchantsmith, you can enchant and improve items using the enchantment books you've collected.

By leveling up the Enchantsmith with Echo Shards, you can also upgrade the enchantments on your items in exchange for Echo Shards and Enchantment Points.

You can use the same enchantment book on multiple items, and if you disenchant an item your enchantment points will be refunded.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_meleeattack_description:
Attack enemies by pressing <input id="melee_attack"/>, and continuously attack by holding <input id="melee_attack"/>. 

Weapons vary in range, speed and attack pattern, so experiment to discover your favourite.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_capes_description:
Capes are a great cosmetic that you can equip to your hero. 

You can obtain capes from different editions of the game and through special promotions.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_companions_description: Companions are a type of talisman that spawns a friendly creature that helps you during combat.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_endgame_overview_ description: Congratulations on beating the game! Here's what you can do now:
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_endgame_overview_rifts_description: Continue to explore <emphasis>Rifts</> and <emphasis>Dungeons</> for thrilling challenges and track down rare <emphasis>Enchantment Books</>!
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_inventory_salvage_overview_descrip: Convert unwanted items into emeralds and claim back some inventory space. You can select any item, open More Actions <input id="moreactions"/> , and Salvage it.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_dungeons_description:
Dungeons are procedurally generated areas. 

Many dangers await you, but fortune favours the bold! There are many rare and powerful items to be found, including Enchantment Books, Echo Shards and more. 

To keep you on your toes, dungeons will often spawn in different places each session.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_consumables_description: Eat food to regenerate health. Great for when you're waiting for potions to refresh.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_emeralds_description: Emeralds are a valuable currency in the game. You can use them to purchase items and upgrade equipment.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_enchantmentbooks_description:
Enchantment books are used to enchant your items at the Enchantsmith. You'll need Enchantment Points to use them! 

Collect enchantment books by completing quests and exploring dungeons and rifts.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_enchantmentpoints_descriptio:
Enchantment points are used to enchant your items at the Enchantsmith. 

You earn one enchantment point each time you level up, and any used enchantment point will be refunded if the item is disenchanted or salvaged.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.actionlist_inventory: Equip items in the inventory <input id="inventory_primary"/>
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_guidance_description: Feeling lost? Press <input id="guidance"/> to fire off a guidance line and follow it to reach your objective!
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_endgame_overview_echo_shards_descr: Fight <emphasis>Soul Corrupted mobs</> and collect precious <emphasis>Echo Shards</> to upgrade your gear and become the strongest hero the Overworld has ever seen.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.actionlist_combat_chargedrange: Hold <input id="ranged_charged_attack"/> for Charged Ranged Attack
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_townportal_description:
If you need to power up before a fight, teleport to Brave Haven by pressing <input id="menu_wheel"/> to open the menu wheel, and then select "Teleport to Brave Haven". 

When you are ready, you can travel back to where you were before by going to the Town Portal in Town, just touch it to travel back.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_collectibles_description: Items that let you upgrade your gear, add some flare to your looks, or bring along unique companions to your adventure.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_gameplay_description: Key events and concepts you'll experience handily explained here.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_blacksmith_overview_description3: Levelling up the Blacksmith unlocks <emphasis>Effects Re-roll</> for your items
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_enchantsmith_overview_description3: Levelling up the Enchantsmith unlocks <emphasis>Enchantment Upgrading</>
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_villagemerchant_overview_descripti: Levelling up the Town Merchant unlocks <emphasis>rare</> and <emphasis>special</> items to purchase
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_minimap_description:
Nearby quest objectives and points of interest are displayed on the minimap as icons, as well as your friends in multiplayer. 

Use the minimap in-game as a quick reference. For a broader view, you can use the map.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_chargedrangedattack_descript:
Perform a charged ranged attack by holding <input id="ranged_charged_attack"/> to charge a shot. When you have a regular Bow equipped, this deals extra damage. 

If you are using a Crossbow, holding <input id="ranged_charged_attack"/> will let you continuously shoot.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_jumpattack_description:
Perform a jump attack by pressing <input id="jump"/> + <input id="melee_jump_attack"/>. 

This type of attack deals extra damage, has a wider range, and has a greater chance of staggering enemies.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_pets_description:
Pets are companions that you can equip and that help you in battle with their unique looks and charisma, even if they don't directly participate in combat. 

You can obtain pets from different editions of the game and through special promotions.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_jump_description: Press <input id="jump"/> to leap over obstacles and explore higher areas.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_rifts_description:
Rifts are procedurally generated areas. 

Many dangers await you, but fortune favours the bold! There are many rare and powerful items to be found, including Enchantment Books, Echo Shards and more. 

To keep you on your toes, rifts will often spawn in different places each session.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_rangedattack_description:
Shoot enemies with <input id="ranged_attack"/>. 

Ranged attacks use ammo, which regenerates over time. No need to scout for arrows!
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_specialgear_description: Some things you might need to know about certain item types you'll find in the world.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_soulstorms_description:
Soul Storms are high paced combat areas that have increased quantity and re-spawn rate of hostile mobs. If you defeat a Soul Storm, you will be generously rewarded. 

They appear randomly in the world every hour and last for around 40 minutes.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_statuses_description: Statuses are buffs or debuffs that affect you, your party or hostile mobs for a limited period of time.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_talisman_overview_description2:
Talismans are unique, collectible rewards.
Select the slot and equip it to <SWDecorator Color="SW.UI.DesignToken.Color.Semantic.Quest.Text.Highlight.Dialogue">gain a passive ability</>.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_talismans_description:
Talismans can be equipped to grant potent passive abilities and you can have a maximum of three talismans at the same time. 

They will gain XP with you and become more powerful the longer you have them equipped. 

Make sure to switch between your talismans to get them to max level to be ready for every type of challenge!
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_endgame_overview_soul_storm_descri: The Illager High Council is activating powerful generators that are triggering cataclysmic <emphasis>Soul Storms</>. Fight the hordes of spawning mobs and destroy the <emphasis>Storm Generators</> to save the world and claim the best gear.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_soulstorm_overview_description_1: The Illager High Council is activating powerful generators that are triggering cataclysmic <emphasis>Soul Storms</>. Fight the hordes of spawning mobs and destroy the <emphasis>Storm Generators</> to save the world and claim the best gear.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_wellspringtides_description:
There are three tides in the Sift time cycle; Flow, Thrive, and Endure. 

Flow: No effect. 
Thrive: Faster Soul regeneration and artifact cooldowns.

Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_souls_description:
Using artifacts costs souls. You collect souls by defeating enemies, but souls also regenerate over time. 

Your soul meter in the hotbar shows your current number of collected souls.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_ambush_description:
When in an ambush, you will get trapped by Soul Walls and mobs will spawn. 

An ambush is cleared when you defeat all mobs that were spawned from that ambush, and then the Soul Walls will disappear.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_healthpotion_description:
When low on health, press <input id="heal"/> to use your health potion to restore it. 

The health potion has a cooldown between uses, and cannot be used while this is active.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_soulimbalance_description:
When playing multiplayer and one member of your party is downed, Soul Imbalance ensues. 

During Soul Imbalance, mobs will spawn and eventually all remaining members will start to take damage every second. 

To stop the Soul Imbalance you must revive all party members. 

Defeating the mobs that spawn during Soul Imbalance does not stop it, so revive your friends as soon as you can!

Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_villagemerchant_description:
You can buy new items with emeralds from the Town Merchant. Stock is refreshed every 30 minutes, but for a small fee of Echo Shards, you can ask them to refresh their stock right away. 

By leveling up the Town Merchant, they offer better gear for sale: 
Level 1: Common items 
Level 2: Rare items 
Level 3: Special items
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_replayablebosses_description:
You can fight defeated bosses again to re-live the experience and get more rewards. 

To re-play a boss, walk up to that area again and find the Boss Totem. Interacting with the Boss Totem will start the boss fight again!
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.panel_soulstorm_overview_description_2: You can find the location of the ongoing Soul Storm on your map.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_springstones_description:
You can obtain Echo Shards by completing Dungeons and Rifts, defeating Bosses and participating in Soul Storms. 

Echo Shards can be used to level up Vendors in Brave Haven in order to expand their functionality and are needed to enchant items. 

Since they are so heavy, you can carry a maximum of 100 Echo Shards.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_teleport_description:
You can teleport to Brave Haven at any time by pressing <input id="teleport_town"/>.

In multiplayer, you can also teleport directly to friends by pressing <input id="teleport"/>.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_levelingup_description:
You gain XP by defeating mobs and completing quests. 

As you gain more XP, you level up and become more powerful - but beware, so do mobs! 

Every level up, you're rewarded with 1 Enchantment Point and your chance of finding rare and more powerful items increases. 

At level 5, a second artifact slot is unlocked. 

At level 10, a third artifact slot is unlocked.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_merchants_description: You'll find merchants in Brave Haven and other locations along the way. Visit them to exchange your riches for a range of services.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_basic_description: You'll need to learn the basics to get your adventure started.
Text/Release/OnboardingLabels.csv.tutoriallog_powerlevel_description: Your power level is determined by the power level of your equipped items. This will effect how powerful you are towards mobs and how much damage they do to you.

Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA01:
<emphasis>Strange rifts have appeared</> across the Overworld, with illager hordes pouring through. The town of <emphasis>Brave Haven is under siege</> and the villagers need your help. 

Drive back the illager forces outside the town gates and <emphasis>investigate these mysterious rifts.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA00:
<emphasis>The Illager High Council attacked your camp!</> They opened strange rifts in thin air and ambushed the villagers.

Sculk has spread from the rifts, corrupting the blocks of the land and attracting swarms of monsters. Now the village is evacuating. Can you help <emphasis>get everyone to safety</>?
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA03:
<emphasis>The Illager High Council has been searching for something</> in the Deep Dark caves. Could this be connected to their plot to dominate the Overworld and the source behind their dangerous new powers? 

To find out, you’ll have to <emphasis>venture down into the Deep Dark</>.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA04:
<emphasis>The Illager High Council shut down the portal to the Sift</> and took away two of the note blocks that power it. Without them, the machine can't play the right keys to unlock the portal, and the Echo Golem will be stuck in this dimension forever. 

<emphasis>Find the Cartographer in Brave Haven</>. They may have some ideas about <emphasis>where the illagers are taking the two note blocks.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.FOa1_S10_A:
<emphasis>The villagers of Little Howl are getting sick</> from eating plants that grew near the sculk. The Cleric's Apprentice had a crazy idea about how to cure the sickness and ran out to gather spider eyes, and now they are missing. 

Can you <emphasis>find the Apprentice</> and bring them home so they can help the Cleric take care of the villagers?
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.PLa2_S16_A:
A villager in Puddle Pond has asked you to look for <emphasis>the Gatherer who still hasn’t returned from picking flowers.</>

If you can <emphasis>find the Gatherer near the Red Tower</> and make sure they haven’t run into any ravager herds, they might pick you a nice bouquet of flowers.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CT_S03_A:
An echo golem has been captured and brought through the portal, only to be <emphasis>robbed of its soul block</> and left in Honeycomb Fields to gather dust.

The illagers who did this can't have gone far! If you <emphasis>find them and retrieve the stolen soul block</> the Echo Golem can be rescued.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CT_S01_A:
An echo golem has been captured and brought through the portal, only to be <emphasis>robbed of its soul block</> and left in the dark Howling Woods.

The illagers who did this can't have gone far! If you <emphasis>find them and retrieve the stolen soul block</> the Echo Golem can be rescued.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CT_S02_A:
An echo golem has been captured and brought through the portal, only to be <emphasis>robbed of its soul block</> and left in the freezing cold of the Frozen Highlands.

The illagers who did this can't have gone far! If you <emphasis>find them and retrieve the stolen soul block,</> the Echo Golem can be rescued.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CT_S04_A:
An echo golem has been captured and brought through the portal, only to be <emphasis>robbed of its soul block</> and left soaking wet in Rainy Plains.

The illagers who did this can't have gone far! If you <emphasis>find them and retrieve the stolen soul block</> the Echo Golem can be rescued before it starts to rust.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.FOa1_S08_A:
Illager poachers are hunting down and caging the wolves of the forest. 

The Wolf Tamer has asked you to <emphasis>follow their pet wolf</> to find its family and free them from the poachers.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA07:
In your quest to retrieve the note blocks, the Cartographer of Brave Haven has sent you to Rainy Plains, where the Supreme Evoker, a member of the Illager High Council, is <emphasis>conducting horrific experiments.</>

If you can <emphasis>reach the Supreme Evoker's tower and find the missing note block,</> you will be one step closer to reopening the portal and helping your echo golem friend return to its own dimension.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.MEa2_S02_A:
On your quest to destroy the portal, the Scared Golem sacrificed their soul block for you. 

If you can <emphasis>find a new soul block,</> the Golem can help you <emphasis>figure out what fresh mischief the Illagers are plotting</> in Lullaby Hills.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CAa1_S03_A:
The <emphasis>illagers are setting up camps too close to the Echo Den</> and they keep bothering the golems and chasing them around. 

The Echo Golem, in its innocence, hopes that you can talk to the illagers and <emphasis>convince them to set up camps elsewhere.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA02_B:
The Cartographer thinks you are ready to <emphasis>search for the entrance to the Deep Dark caves.</> They suggest you <emphasis>return to Little Howl and make your way deeper into Howling Woods.</> 

Find out what the Illager High Council is hiding in those caves! But be careful: the Supreme Evoker has learned how to use soul power to <emphasis>corrupt monsters and creatures</> into powerful soldiers who do their bidding.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.MEa1_S06_A:
The Echo Golem was watching over the wobbles when they all got scared and bounced away. 

Can you <emphasis>make sure all the wobbles are safe</> from illagers and whatever else that might be skulking around the meadows?
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA02_C:
The Enchantsmith is not sure you are strong enough to challenge the Illager High Council and their dangerous new soul magic. 

To prove your worth, you have been tasked with tracking down a particularly nasty Evoker and <emphasis>retrieve some stolen enchantment books.</> If you can <emphasis>improve your items with powerful enchantments,</> you may be ready to face off against the enemy.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.PLa1_S08_A:
The Farmer is waiting for their friend, the Candlemaker, who has just crafted a new type of <emphasis>candle with explosive qualities</> and is excited to show it off. However, over the last few days, the Candlemaker has felt as though someone is spying on them, planning to steal the candles. 

Can you <emphasis>visit the Candlemaker's den</> and make sure they are okay?
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.DEa1_S14_A:
The Fisher left their fishing equipment in the ice caves and now the illagers have set up their new base in there. 

Can you <emphasis>brave the cold caves and return the equipment</> to the fishers so that they can keep the villagers in the fortress fed?
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA02:
The Illager High Council is hiding something important in Howling Woods. It may be connected to the rifts and how they have obtained their dangerous new soul magic. 

<emphasis>The villagers of Little Howl may know more,</> but nobody has heard a hrrm from Little Howl in a little while.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.PLa2_S15_A:
The Inventor in Puddle Pond wants you to pursue the illagers who scavenged the Supreme Evoker’s Monstrosity and <emphasis>stop them from transporting the copper out of Rainy Plains.</> 

<emphasis>Recover the copper</> so that the illagers can’t use it to create another Copper Monstrosity.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.DEa1_S12_A:
The Librarian was looking for some lavatory reading in the library towers, which are still occupied by illagers. There, they overheard the illagers discussing something they were looking for in the old ruins, where they say the Arch-Illager once used to conduct experiments. 

If you <emphasis>search the ruins and find out what the illagers are looking for,</> the Librarian thinks that a disaster can be averted.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.DEa1_S13_A:
The Miner escaped after being held captive and forced to dig a tunnel. 

Can you <emphasis>chase away the illagers</> coming after them and <emphasis>find out why they are digging tunnels?</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA08_B:
The Singer is grateful that you stopped the illagers from taking control of this portal, but the roots of the illager invasion lead much deeper into the Sift. <emphasis>They must be in control of another portal</> somewhere beyond Singer's Meadow. 

<emphasis>Travel through the musical gates</> to the other side of Singer's Meadow and <emphasis>make your way to Humbler Huskland.</> But beware, there is something monstrous guarding the path ahead.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.MEa1_S05_A:
The Singer is worried about <emphasis>the sifters that roam the wild meadows</> nearby. They have been driven mad by the presence of the invasive illagers. 

Can you head into the wild meadows and <emphasis>rip out the illager invasion by the roots of their banners,</> so the sifters can have peace again?
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.MEa2_S03_A:
The illagers <emphasis>stole all the soul blocks</> from the echo golems of Lullaby Hills and took them to <emphasis>their fortress</> on the other side of the chasm. Maybe the soul blocks are still there. 

If you can <emphasis>find them,</> the Echo Golem won’t be so alone anymore.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA09:
The illagers are trying to harvest the soul-rich ichor, but this is <emphasis>angering the territorial sculkers</>. Even <emphasis>the sculker Monarch is stirring.</>

The musical gate blocks the path ahead, but the Echo Golem has warned you that the <emphasis>sculkers like keeping the tuners around</> when they bathe in the ichor. If you want to <emphasis>cross Humbler Huskland</> and reach the illager-controlled portal, you will have to disturb their bath time.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA08:
The mystical Singer of the Sift is worried about their echo golems. Usually, they can hear their songs even from far away, but now many of the echo golems have gone quiet.

They urge you to go and check on them to <emphasis>see why the songs of the echo golems have gone silent.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.PLa1_S04_A:
The patches of sculk that have spread from the illager rifts are poisoning the flowers nearby and risk making the poor bees sick. 

The Beekeeper wants your help to <emphasis>build beehives</> and save the bees of Honeycomb Fields.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA07_BR:
The runes on the stone seem to be some kind of incantation that could revive the Copper Monstrosity.

If you read the incantation aloud, the Copper Monstrosity will be revived. Would you like to <emphasis>fight the Copper Monstrosity again?</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA05_BR:
The runes on the stone seem to be some kind of incantation that could revive the Prime Enchanter.

If you read the incantation aloud, the Prime Enchanter will be revived. Would you like to <emphasis>fight the Prime Enchanter again?</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA10_BR_B:
The runes on the stone seem to be some kind of incantation that could revive the Redstone Monstrosity.

If you read the incantation aloud, the Redstone Monstrosity will be revived. Would you like to <emphasis>fight the Redstone Monstrosity again?</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA09_BR:
The runes on the stone seem to be some kind of incantation that could revive the Sculk Monstrosity.

If you read the incantation aloud, the Sculk Monstrosity will be revived. Would you like to <emphasis>fight the Sculk Monstrosity again?</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA10_BR:
The runes on the stone seem to be some kind of incantation that could revive the Supreme Evoker.

If you read the incantation aloud, the Supreme Evoker will be revived. Would you like to <emphasis>fight the Supreme Evoker and their Monstrous Opus again?</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA03_BR:
The runes on the stone seem to be some kind of incantation that could revive the Twisted Warden.

If you read the incantation aloud, the Twisted Warden will be revived. Would you like to <emphasis>fight the Twisted Warden again?</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA02_B_BR:
The runes on the stone seem to be some kind of incantation that could revive the witch who used to live here.

If you read the incantation aloud, the witch will be revived. Would you like to <emphasis>fight the soul corrupted witch again?</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.PLa2_S17_A:
The villagers of Puddle Pond have heard rumors that <emphasis>a group of illagers have continued the Supreme Evoker’s soul corrupting experiments.</> Except now, with no more monsters or villagers to use as test subjects, <emphasis>they have started experimenting on themselves!</> 

You must <emphasis>investigate the Red Tower</> and stop these mad illagers, or they might take back control over Rainy Plains.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA05:
The villagers of the Frozen Highlands need your help. The Prime Enchanter, a member of the Illager High Council, terrorizes the highlands from some hidden base. 

Maybe that is where they are <emphasis>hiding the second note block?</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA01_B:
There are rumors that <emphasis>the Illager High Council has been exploring the Deep Dark caves of Howling Woods.</> It may be connected to the rifts and how they have obtained their dangerous new powers. 

The Merchant from Brave Haven was last seen heading toward the bridge into Howling Woods. <emphasis>Find the Merchant</> and make your way into Howling Woods.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CAa1_S02_A:
With all the disharmony lately, some echo golems were growing weak and wobbled off towards the ichor springs to recharge their soul blocks. <emphasis>Three of them have now gone missing,</> and their friend worries they may have run out of power on the way. 

Unless you <emphasis>collect some ichor crust in the ichor springs, find the lost golems,</> and help recharge them, their precious soul blocks may fall into the hands of the illagers.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA06:
With the note blocks collected, you can finally activate the ancient portal, help your golem friend return to the Sift and start to investigate what the illagers are actually plotting in the new dimension.

First, <emphasis>return to the Cartographer in Brave Haven,</> they will know what to do.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptions.csv.CA10:
Your journey through the Sift has brought you to <emphasis>the ravaged Lullaby Hills,</> where the Illagers are said to have opened a portal back to the Overworld and are <emphasis>pumping out all the souly ichor,</> the lifeblood of this dimension. 

If you can <emphasis>find the portal and shut it down,</> there may still be a chance for the Sift to begin to heal.

Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA09:
<emphasis>In search of the illager-controlled portal, you traversed Humbler Huskland</> where the illagers were trying to capture tuners to stop you from reaching the other side.

However, the sculkers were not happy with Overworlders meddling with the tuners or corrupting the ichor, and in the end, you had to defeat an angry sculker Monarch to make it out of Humbler Huskland and <emphasis>into Lullaby Hills.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA00:
<emphasis>The Illager High Council attacked your camp.</> They opened strange rifts in thin air and ambushed the villagers.

Sculk spread from the rifts, corrupting the very blocks of Squid Coast. You had no other choice but to leave your home. Luckily, the villagers of <emphasis>Brave Haven</> welcomed you with open arms... figuratively speaking.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..PLa1_S04_A:
<emphasis>Weird patches of sculk have spread from the illager rifts</> and poisoned the nearby flowers. 

The Beekeeper was worried that the poor <emphasis>bees could get sick,</> but now that <emphasis>you have built new hives,</> the Beekeeper and their buzzing buddies can continue making tasty honey and spreading healthy pollen across the meadows of Honeycomb Fields.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..PLa2_S16_A:
<emphasis>You tracked down the Gatherer and helped them pick some flowers</> from the places where the ravagers roam. 

The Gatherer showed their gratitude by arranging the flowers into a beautiful bouquet and offering a heart-shaped talisman to their very own wildflower warrior.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..PLa2_S17_A:
A group of illagers moved back into the Red Tower to continue the Supreme Evoker's soul corrupting experiments, now experimenting on themselves!

You saved the villager they had captured and hunted down the troops before they were able to take back the other towers of Rainy Plains. <emphasis>Let's hope this puts an end to the experiments in Rainy Plains.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..PLa2_S15_A:
A group of illagers scavenged the Supreme Evoker's monstrosity and tried to transport the copper out of Rainy Plains to use it for a new monstrosity. 

<emphasis>You hunted down the illagers and brought the copper to the Inventor</> who used it to design a weapon for you instead.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA05:
After <emphasis>discovering the Prime Enchanter's hidden lair</> deep inside the Frozen Fortress, you defeated the ice-knuckled tyrant and helped the villagers take shelter inside.

<emphasis>Now you have both note blocks</> needed to activate the ancient portal and help your echo golem friend home to its own dimension. Not to mention that the Illager High Council is one member short. Nice work!
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA06:
After <emphasis>retrieving the note blocks and returning them to the Deep Dark,</> the note block machine could play the keys to unlock the ancient portal. All the echo golems who had been captured and brought to the Overworld were able to return home and finally reunite with the Singer who sang them into life.

Now you only have to find out what devious schemes the illagers are actually planning in the Sift, and put an end to them.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA04:
After <emphasis>tracking down the Blacksmith</> in Howling Woods and <emphasis>reaching the Woodcutter's Outpost,</> the Blacksmith offered to help sharpen your weapons and strengthen your steel. 

Now you may stand a chance against the Illager High Council as you <emphasis>continue your search for the two missing note blocks.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA02:
After chasing the illagers out of Little Howl Hamlet, you found yourselves once again in the new dimension where you got to witness <emphasis>the enigmatic Singer creating a soul block.</>

Back in Little Howl, the Village Cleric thanked you for liberating them and confirmed the rumors that the Illager High Council are searching for something in the Deep Dark caves. <emphasis>The Enchantsmith should know more...</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA08_B:
After finding out that <emphasis>the Illager High Council must be in control of another portal</> somewhere beyond Singer's Meadow, you defeated the sculk monstrosity that guarded the pass and <emphasis>crossed the border to Humbler Huskland.</>

One step closer to discovering the root of the illager invasion.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA02_B:
After finding the path through the forest and rescuing lost foragers on the way, <emphasis>the Supreme Evoker appeared</> and used their soul-corrupting powers on a witch to stop you from reaching the cave entrance. Still, with everything you've learned on your journey, <emphasis>not even a soul corrupted witch could stand in your way.</>

Now there is only one way forward: <emphasis>down into the Deep Dark.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..MEa2_S03_A: After storming the illager stronghold and returning with the stolen soul blocks, the echo golems can sing together again and <emphasis>start to bring harmony back to Lullaby Hills.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..FOa1_S10_A:
Some villagers got sick from eating plants that grew near the sculk. 

After <emphasis>tracking down the missing Cleric's Apprentice</> who got captured gathering soul corrupted spider eyes, they were able to <emphasis>create a cure for the villagers.</> Now, they have enough soul corrupted spider eyes to cure in case more villagers get sick.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CT_S04_A:
The Echo Golem was captured and brought through the portal, only to be <emphasis>robbed of its soul block</> and left in the Rainy Plains.

After defeating the responsible illagers and reviving the Golem, it waddled <emphasis>back to the portal in the Deep Dark</> to grease its rusty joints in a nice, long ichor bath.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA02_C:
The Enchantsmith wasn't very optimistic about your chances against the Illager High Council. 

But after tracking down some stolen enchantment books and even braving the depths of a dangerous dungeon, the Enchantsmith has changed their tune and promised to help <emphasis>enchant your gear</> whenever you need.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..PLa1_S08_A:
The Farmer sent you to check on their friend, the Candlemaker, only to find they had been attacked by illagers who stole their new invention: <emphasis>the explosive Creeper Candle!</> After stopping the illagers from blowing up the food storage in Honeycomb Fields, you followed a map to extinguish several candles planted to cause destruction.

The Candlemaker thanked you for defusing the illager plot, hoping that Creeper Candles will now only end up in the hands of <emphasis>heroes who use them responsibly.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..DEa1_S14_A:
The Fisher left their fishing equipment in the ice caves. Lucky for them, you made your way through the caves, defeated the illagers who had set up camp inside, and <emphasis>retrieved the fishing gear.</> 

Now the villagers in the fortress won't have to worry about going hungry.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..DEa1_S12_A:
The Librarian overheard some illagers discussing a project they were working on in the old ruins where the Arch-Illager once used to conduct experiments. After translating some old runes in the library towers, you (rather foolishly) read the runes out loud and <emphasis>awoke a Sculk Monstrosity</> that must have been slumbering underground for a very long time. 

At least now the villagers of Frozen Highlands won't have to worry that the illagers will wake the monstrosity when you're not here to stop it.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA07:
The Supreme Evoker was terrorizing the Rainy Plains and capturing villagers to perform horrific experiments. You waded across the wetlands, stormed the illager towers, and rescued the captured villagers. In the end, you confronted the Supreme Evoker, destroyed their monstrous creation of soul-powered copper and <emphasis>found the first note block.</>

<emphasis>The Supreme Evoker got away this time</> and is already working on perfecting their design to build one final monsterpiece.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CT_S03_A:
The echo golem was captured and brought through the portal, only to be <emphasis>robbed of its soul block</> and left in Honeycomb Fields to gather dust.

After defeating the responsible illagers and reviving the echo golem, it hurried <emphasis>back to the portal in the Deep Dark,</> sneezing as it went.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CT_S01_A:
The echo golem was captured and brought through the portal, only to be <emphasis>robbed of its soul block</> and left in the dark Howling Woods.

After defeating the responsible illagers and reviving the echo golem, it hurried <emphasis>back to the portal in the Deep Dark</> to get out of this scary forest.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CT_S02_A:
The echo golem was captured and brought through the portal, only to be <emphasis>robbed of its soul block</> and left in the freezing cold of the Frozen Highlands.

After defeating the responsible illagers and reviving the echo golem, it hurried through the weird, white mush <emphasis>to find the portal in the Deep Dark</>.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA01_B:
The illagers sabotaged the bridge into Howling Woods and even attacked the poor Merchant tasked with repairing it.

After finding the Merchant and escorting them back to their stall in Brave Haven, they crafted a new bridge lever. Now you can find out why the Illager High Council is so adamant about keeping you out of Howling Woods. <emphasis>What are they hiding?</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..DEa1_S13_A:
The illagers were forcing captured miners to dig a tunnel into the fortress so they could ambush the villagers taking refuge there. 

But after rescuing the captives and intercepting the illager troops before they could attack, <emphasis>you restored peace in the fortress.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CAa1_S03_A:
The illagers were setting up camps too close to the Echo Den, and bothering all the innocent golems. The Echo Golem doesn't know how you convinced the illagers to move, but <emphasis>you must have made some really good points!</> 

Now they can finally have peace in the Echo Den.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..MEa1_S05_A:
The sifters were going mad by the presence of the invasive illagers in their territory.

After you ripped out the illagers by the roots of their banners, the Singer and the echo golems hope that the sifters might calm down a little and finally have some peace in their nests.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..MEa1_S06_A:
The wobbles all got scared by illagers and bounced away to hide in bushes. One of them even bounced into the meadows beyond the musical gate where some scary sculkers were roaming, far from their usual territory in the ravines.

Now with your help, <emphasis>the wobbles are all back to safety,</> and one of them has even been inspired by your bravery and wants to <emphasis>follow you on your quest to save the Sift.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CAa1_S02_A:
With all the disharmony in the Sift, three echo golems were growing weak and went to recharge their soul blocks in the ichor springs. After running out of power on the way, it was up to you to collect ichor crust from the springs, find the lost golems, and recharge them before their precious soul blocks fell into the hands of the illagers.

<emphasis>Now they can sing together with their choir in the Echo Den again.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA03:
You braved the Deep Dark and discovered that <emphasis>the Illager High Council had been able to activate one of the ancient portals.</> After chasing them away and fighting the Supreme Evoker's twisted pet, you rescued the Echo Golem they were holding captive.

If the portal is activated again, the Echo Golem can return home to the Sift. However, before they ran off, it seemed like <emphasis>the illagers did something to the machine that powers the portal.</>
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA01:
You drove the illagers away from Brave Haven and Honeycomb Farm and came face to face with the Supreme Evoker and the Grand Illusioner, leaders of the Illager High Council. Chasing after them through a rift, <emphasis>you entered a whole new dimension... the Sift.</> Now you know how they have been attacking villages out of thin air. 

The Farmer may have an idea about where to <emphasis>search for the Illager High Council</> when you are ready.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA05_BR: You fought the Prime Enchanter again! Nice.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA10_BR: You fought the Supreme Evoker and their monstrous opus again! Nice.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA07_BR: You fought the copper monstrosity again! Nice.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA010_BR_B: You fought the redstone monstrosity again! Nice.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA09_BR: You fought the sculk monstrosity again! Nice.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA03_BR: You fought the twisted warden again! Nice.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA02_B_BR: You fought the witch again! Nice.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA08:
You found the kidnapped echo golems and the stolen soul blocks before discovering that it was all part of a plot to lure you away while the Illager High Council ambushed the Singer and took control of the portal.

Since you stopped the illager plot, <emphasis>the Singer gave you the gift of song,</> marking you as a true friend of the Sift. Now <emphasis>the tuners that unlock the musical gates</> will trust you, and you can explore more of this dimension.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..MEa2_S02_A:
You rewarded the bravery of the scared echo golem with <emphasis>a brand new soul block,</> and took care of <emphasis>some illagers that were up to funny business</> in Lullaby Hills. 

Now the echo golem can finally relax and sing. If only it didn't have to sing alone...
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..FOa1_S08_A: You tracked down the illager poachers and rescued the kidnapped wolves. Now you will always have a place in their pack.
Text/Release/QuestDescriptionsCompleted..CA10:
You travelled across the Overworld and traversed the Sift. You fought illagers, monsters, sifters, sculkers and monstrosities. You struck down the ice-knuckled Prime Enchanter, defeated the Supreme Evoker and silenced their Monstrous Opus. You even destroyed the corrupted portal that was hurting the Sift. 

All across the dimensions, villagers and echo golems celebrated that <emphasis>the Illager High Council was thwarted.</> Although they are still out there, somewhere, plotting their next move, <emphasis>you will be ready for them, should they return.</>

Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Carapac.CAa1_S02_A_QuestEnd_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: <emphasis>The whole choir is together again,</> singing and harmonizing. They sing you a song of gratitude for braving the dangerous ichor springs to save them.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Carapac.CAa1_S03_A_QuestStart_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Echo Golem chirps with worry. There are <emphasis>too many illagers setting up camps nearby.</> They keep bothering all the golems and chasing them around.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Carapac.CAa1_S03_A_I02_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Echo Golem doesn't know how you convinced the illagers to move, but <emphasis>you must have made some really good points!</> Now they can finally have peace in the Echo Den.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Carapac.CAa1_S02_A_I08_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Echo Golem jolts awake when they receive the ichor crust. That's the stuff! <emphasis>They head back to the Echo Den</> for choir practice.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Carapac.CAa1_S02_A_QuestStart_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Echo Golem wonders if you've seen the rest of its little choir. <emphasis>They were last seen wobbling off towards the ichor springs</> to recharge their soul blocks.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Carapac.CAa1_S02_A_I09_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Golem powers on with a whirr. That's some yummy crust! <emphasis>They hurry back home</> to sing with their friends.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Carapac.CAa1_S03_A_QuestStart_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Golem tried to ask them to set up camps elsewhere, but the illagers became angry! Maybe you could talk to the illagers and <emphasis>convince them to move.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Carapac.CAa1_S02_A_QuestStart_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The flowing ichor will hurt if you touch it, but the crust that forms on the banks should be safe even for an Overworlder. <emphasis>Bring it to the lost golems</> before the illagers find them!
The golems have been growing weak with all the disharmony lately and may have run out of power on the way. If you pass through Ichor Ponds or Sculker Springs, <emphasis>collect some ichor crust.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Carapac.CAa1_S02_A_I11_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The ichor crust makes the soul block shine as bright as ever. Real brainfood! <emphasis>The Golem wobbles off</> to meet its friends.

Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_CartographerQuestgiver_Dialogue1_Pa: Although... Nobody has heard a <emphasis>hrrm</> from Little Howl in a little while.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: Usually, the Singer can hear the songs of their echo golems, no matter how far away they are... yet somehow <emphasis>many of the echo golems have gone quiet.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_C_EnchantsmithOutpost_Dialogue1_Par: <Emphasis>Track the evoker down and retrieve the enchantment books.</> Only then will you be powerful enough to challenge the High Council.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA06_Cartographer01_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: <emphasis>Bring them to the machine in the Deep Dark</> and play the right keys to open the portal. Finally, those echo golems will be able to return home.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_B_CartographerQuestgiver_Dialogue1_: <emphasis>Search for the entrance to those caves</> and find out what the Illager High Council is up to. But be careful, the Supreme Evoker is using soul power to twist and corrupt all kinds of creatures in the forest.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_B_Gate01_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: <emphasis>Take down the banners in the illager guardposts</> so they send out reinforcements. Then they will have to open the gate, letting you slip through.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph4: <emphasis>The Blacksmith of Brave Haven</> is on their way to the Woodcutter's Outpost right now. If you can <emphasis>catch up to them in Howling Woods,</> they will show you the way through the forest.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_B_SpiderCaveExitVillager_Dialogue1_: <emphasis>The Deep Dark caves are just up ahead!</> But beware: a witch lives by the entrance. Given how bravely you fought in the Spider Caves, however, <emphasis>one little witch shouldn't be a problem.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_DepoweredCaretaker04_Dialogue1_Para: <emphasis>The Echo Golem is missing the soul block</> in its head, the usual upbeat chirping silenced.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: <emphasis>The Echo Golem is reunited with the Singer,</> and the two of them chatter in a flurry of musical chirps. The Singer's notes are complex and unusual, so the Echo Golem steps in to translate.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_Interact01_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: <emphasis>The Inventor who is keeping watch up on the hill</> has figured out how to activate the illager bridges. They can tell you how to reach the towers and stop the Supreme Evoker.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_B_BridgeVillager_Dialogue1_Paragrap: <emphasis>The Merchant from Brave Haven</> was on their way to fix it, but they seem to have gotten lost between here and town. <emphasis>Can you find them?</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_ReturnToOasis_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: <emphasis>The Supreme Evoker fled,</> but they are surely working on something even more monstrous already. At least they are far away from Puddle Pond.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: <emphasis>The Villager fled from their home</> in the Frozen Highlands when the illagers attacked.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_DepoweredCaretaker03_Dialogue1_Para: <emphasis>The illagers have stolen the Golem's soul block,</> leaving it an empty shell.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: <emphasis>The portal lies in Lullaby Hills,</> on the other side of the Huskland, and <emphasis>the illagers are doing everything to block the path.</> Still, there are more dangerous things skulking around than illagers.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_DepoweredCaretaker02_Dialogue1_Para: <emphasis>The soul block is missing</> from the Echo Golem's head. This handiwork looks familiar...
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA03_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: Are you ready to <Emphasis>head down into the Deep Dark</> and discover what the Illager High Council is hiding down there?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_B_VillageMerchantTown_Dialogue1_Par: As you make to leave, the Merchant hurriedly gestures towards their inventory. Why not spend a few emeralds on some crisp <emphasis>new items</> or an <emphasis>awesome artifact?</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph4: But <emphasis>this is drawing the scary sculkers</> up from their home in the ravines... and even the <emphasis>sculker Monarch</> is stirring.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_CaretakerHub_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: But it isn't the illagers that are scaring the golems. <emphasis>It's the sculkers.</> They don't like Overworlders meddling with their tuners. Be careful.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_B_QuestGiver01_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: But the roots of the illager invasion lead much deeper into the Sift. <emphasis>They must be in control of another portal</> somewhere beyond Singer's Meadow.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: Can you <emphasis>check on their friends in Frostrime Village</> and make sure that everyone got out safely? Maybe they will know where to look for the Prime Enchanter's hidden base.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_FortressVillager01_Dialogue1_Paragr: Especially since no one knows <emphasis>where the Prime Enchanter is hiding</> their secret headquarters.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_C_EnchantsmithTown_Dialogue1_Paragr: However, the last enchantment book is still missing, and that rude evoker was seen opening <Emphasis>one of the dungeons outside of town.</> They love hiding books away in dungeons.
If you <Emphasis>brave the depths of the dungeon</> and bring the book back to Brave Haven, the Enchantsmith will help you get ready for battle.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_BridgeVillager01_Dialogue1_Paragrap: If you <emphasis>search the old shipwrecks</> that are frozen in the ice, you might find planks to build a new bridge so that the last survivor can cross.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_B_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: If you are heading to the Deep Dark caves, can you <emphasis>keep an eye out for lost foragers</> on the way?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_Caretaker04_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: If you can <emphasis>bring the ichor cores back to the gate,</> the Echo Golem can find their friend in Lullaby Hills.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_B_VillageMerchantAmbush_Dialogue1_P: If you can find those thieving illagers and <emphasis>recover the supplies,</> the Merchant will <emphasis>meet you at Honeycomb Farm.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA03_TrappedCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragrap: If you can just <emphasis>get the note block machine activated again,</> the portal will reopen and the Golem can return home to the Sift.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_GateVillager_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: If you really are brave enough to open the gate and face the illagers, you'll have to <emphasis>find where the key golem is hiding.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_C_EnchantsmithOutpost_Dialogue1_Par: If you really mean business, you will need to <Emphasis>prepare yourself with powers of your own.</> One of those nasty evokers stole some enchantment books from the Enchantsmith.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: If you want to help the poor Echo Golem home and get to the bottom of what the Illager High Council is planning with the Sift, you will need to <emphasis>find those two note blocks.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA03_FreedCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph5: It wonders if you can also keep an eye out for lost golems <emphasis>during your quest to recover the missing note blocks.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA06_FortressVillager01_Dialogue1_Paragr: Looks like the villagers can finally stop shivering thanks to your heroic efforts in defeating the Prime Enchanter and finding them a new home.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA00_VillagerDocks01_Dialogue1_Paragraph: Maybe you can find safety somewhere... <emphasis>across the water.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_B_OptionalCaretaker_Dialogue1_Parag: Now that you have received the gift of song, <emphasis>the tuners will follow you</> and tune the musical gates to the right key.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_C_EnchantsmithTown_Dialogue2_Paragr: Now that you know that <Emphasis>enchantment books can be found in dungeons,</> the Enchantsmith is slightly more hopeful about your chances against the Illager High Council.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_CartographerQuestgiver_Dialogue1_Pa: Now that your weapons are sharper and sturdier, the Cartographer suggests you <emphasis>take the minecart back to Woodcutter's Outpost.</> Someone there should be able to show you the way <emphasis>into Rainy Plains.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_Blacksmith01_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: Now the woodcutters will be able to clear the fallen tree, so long as you have their backs in case <emphasis>monsters attack.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_AngryCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: Realizing you are not an illager coming for its soul block, the Golem whistles with relief. It was <emphasis>separated from its friends</> when the illagers attacked and has been too scared to make its way back.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_SoulConstruct_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: So this is <emphasis>why the Illager High Council has been pumping ichor out of the Sift.</> This must be what they've been building up to. Their ultimate masterpiece... their <emphasis>monstrous opus!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_Caretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph4: Suddenly... there is a strange sound in the wind and the Golem lets out a chirp of exhilaration. <emphasis>The Singer is about to sing!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_C_EnchantsmithOutpostReturn_Dialogu: That vile evoker got away with their most powerful enchantment book. Still, the Enchantsmith may have an idea <Emphasis>where they are hiding out.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_Blacksmith01_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Blacksmith was working with the woodcutters to clear the path to their outpost when some <emphasis>illagers took their axes</> and ran off. Not going to get far without them.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_Blacksmith01_Dialogue4_Paragraph1: The Blacksmith welcomes you to the Woodcutter's Outpost. <emphasis>The areas beyond this place are ruled by the Illager High Council.</> If that's where you're heading, you better stay sharp.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_Blacksmith01_Dialogue5_Paragraph1: The Blacksmith, happy to be warmed by their furnace once more, offers to <emphasis>keep your steel strong and your blades sharp</> in your fight against the Illager High Council.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Cartographer gasps as you tell them that <emphasis>the portals have opened after all this time...</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_CartographerQuestgiver_Dialogue1_Pa: The Cartographer has heard that <emphasis>the Supreme Evoker is conducting soul-powered experiments</> in the towers scattered across the plains. It is likely they would be keeping <emphasis>one of the note blocks</> close by.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_B_CartographerQuestgiver_Dialogue1_: The Cartographer is happy to hear that you have learned how to use enchantments. They suggest you <emphasis>take the minecart back to Little Howl</> and make your way deeper into Howling Woods.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_CartographerQuestgiver_Dialogue1_Pa: The Cartographer is worried to hear that <emphasis>the Illager High Council is searching around the Deep Dark caves</> of Howling Woods. There is nothing but trouble to find down there.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA06_Cartographer01_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Cartographer raises their eyebrows with admiration as they see <emphasis>you have found the missing note blocks.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Cartographer welcomes you to Brave Haven and wants you to think of this as your new home. Unfortunately, <emphasis>Brave Haven has troubles of their own...</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_OldVillager_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Cleric of Little Howl is grateful that <emphasis>you chased the illagers away</> and closed the rift. What strange things you must have seen on the other side!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA06_Caretaker1_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Echo Golem chirps with excitement! You found the missing note blocks. <emphasis>Now the note block machine can play the keys to unlock the portal</> and the golems can finally go home.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_Caretaker04_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Echo Golem got separated from its friend who was visiting Lullaby Hills on the other side of the gate, and <emphasis>illagers have taken the ichor cores</> that activate the gate.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_DepoweredCaretaker01_Dialogue1_Para: The Echo Golem is silent and unmoving. <emphasis>The soul block in its head is missing.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_QuestGiver01_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: The Echo Golem listens hypnotically to the Singer's humming before it relays the message with uncontained excitement.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_VistaCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: The Echo Golem may be scared, but if you make sure the path is safe, it can <emphasis>show you the way to the illager stronghold.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Echo Golem welcomes you with a little song to Humbler Huskland but informs you that <emphasis>there is no portal in these parts.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_CapturedCaretaker01_Dialogue1_Parag: The Echo Golem whistles a frantic warning. The illagers only kidnapped the golems to <emphasis>lure you away.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_OptionalCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragra: The Echo Golem whistles that the key tuners are a picky bunch and they'd never follow someone so out of tune.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_Caretaker01_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: The Echo Golem whistles worriedly about the scary sculker Monarch. <emphasis>Find the Echo Den!</> The golems there will know how to cross the Huskland without stirring the sculkers.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_C_EnchantsmithOutpost_Dialogue1_Par: The Enchantsmith warns you against heading further into Howling Woods. The Illager High Council has managed to harness strange powers from that new dimension. <Emphasis>You won't stand a chance!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_BarnVillager_Dialogue3_Paragraph1: The Farmer breathes a sigh of relief. The worst of the illager invasion has been pushed back from the farm for now. Still, <emphasis>they will keep attacking until somebody stops them.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_BarnVillager_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: The Farmer came to warn you. <emphasis>The Illager High Council is coming!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_B_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Farmer has heard rumours from the Merchant that the Illager High Council has been exploring <emphasis>the Deep Dark caves of Howling Woods.</> Could that have something to do with all of this?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_BarnVillager_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Farmer is breathless since they just fled from their fields when <emphasis>the Illager High Council attacked.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_BarnVillager_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: The Farmer saw one of the Council leaders, <emphasis>the Grand Illusioner,</> use their staff to rip open a rift, releasing <emphasis>blue-glowing monsters into their fields!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_B_ForagerEnding_Dialogue1_Paragraph: The Forager gathered enough courage to check on you. Whenever you are ready to head down into the Deep Dark, <emphasis>they will show you the way.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_B_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Forager is waiting for their friends to return from foraging mushrooms. They have been out way past several bedtimes!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_B_SpiderCaveEntranceVillager_Dialog: The Forager is worried about <emphasis>their friends, who went into the Spider Caves</> looking for suspicious mushrooms. They should have been out by now! Suspicious, indeed.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_Caretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: The Golem can tell that <emphasis>you are different from the other visitors</> who have been running around, tearing up rifts and causing chaos.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA03_FreedCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Golem chimes sadly. This note block machine is used to power the portal, but <emphasis>the Illager High Council escaped with two of the note blocks.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_VistaCaretaker_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: The Golem chirps helplessly. The illagers have sealed the path ahead with <emphasis>a gate that can only be opened with the power of a soul block.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_Caretaker04_Dialogue3_Paragraph1: The Golem is extremely happy to finally be reunited with its friend so they can sing together again! Although... <emphasis>its friend seems sadder than usual.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_CapturedCaretaker01_Dialogue1_Parag: The Golem promises to bring the soul blocks back to its friends, but you need to <emphasis>get back to the portal and defend the Singer</> from the illagers that are on the way!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_VistaCaretaker_Dialogue2_Paragraph3: The Golem seems to get an idea, its song growing stronger and brighter for the first time since you met. Somebody has to stop these nasty illagers!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_CaretakerHub_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Golem welcomes you to its Echo Den. This is where the echo golems of Humbler Huskland usually meet to sing together.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_Caretaker04_Dialogue3_Paragraph2: The Golem will try to find out why its friend is sad. Better <emphasis>give them a moment to catch up</> and find their tune.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Happy Golem tries to comfort its friend, but the Sad Golem only wants to sing songs in minor key after it saw <emphasis>what awful things the illagers had done to Lullaby Hills...</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_OverlookVillager_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Inventor <emphasis>offers you the ichor core so you can cross the first bridge.</> The rest are being kept at the top of the towers, and <emphasis>you'll need three more to reach the Supreme Evoker's tower.</>

The Inventor has been watching the illagers through the spyglass. The Supreme Evoker has mined all the copper in the area and is <emphasis>building something monstrous at the top of the central tower.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_B_VillageMerchantAmbush_Dialogue1_P: The Merchant dances with joy that you rescued them. They were on their way to fix the broken bridge lever, but <emphasis>the illagers stole their supplies.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_B_VillageMerchantFarm_Dialogue1_Par: The Merchant is going to hitch a ride back to Brave Haven <emphasis>using the minecarts</> and suggests you follow them.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_B_VillageMerchantTown_Dialogue1_Par: The Merchant is relieved to be back in their stall and hands you <emphasis>the new bridge lever</> they crafted. Now you can figure out what the Illager High Council is hiding in Howling Woods.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_OasisWoodcutter_Dialogue1_Paragraph: The Prime Enchanter terrorizes the highlands from their hidden headquarters, but nobody knows where it is. <emphasis>A hidden base would be the perfect place to hide a note block...</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_AngryCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Scared Golem has nowhere to run! It pleads for you <emphasis>not to take its soul block.</> It has all its memories and melodies in there.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_VistaCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Scared Golem whistles sadly. <emphasis>Its friends have been silenced,</> robbed of all their memories and all their melodies.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: The Singer is grateful for all you've done, but they're also worried. The invaders, whom you call illagers, haven't reached this last safe haven, but <emphasis>something is still very wrong.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_B_QuestGiver01_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Singer wails a worried melody and the Echo Golem tries to keep up with its translation. You may have <emphasis>stopped the illagers from taking control of this portal...</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_QuestGiver01_Dialogue2_Paragraph2: The Singer wants to show their gratitude by giving you a gift. <emphasis>A gift that will help you move through this dimension</> and see more of the world they love so much.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_B_QuestGiver01_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: The Singer wants you to <emphasis>travel through the musical gate</> to the other side of the meadows. But be careful, there is a roar in the wind. <emphasis>Something monstrous guards the pass into Humbler Huskland.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Villager fled from Rainy Plains when the illagers invaded. They mark a village on your map: <emphasis>Puddle Pond.</> The villagers there will know more about what the Supreme Evoker is up to.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_BridgeVillager02_Dialogue2_Paragrap: The Villager is excited to see so many survivors. They all hurry to the <emphasis>entrance of the abandoned fortress</> to reunite with their friends and find safety.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_Questgiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Villager is excited to see that <emphasis>you brought the new bridge lever.</> With the bridge open, maybe they can finally hear word from their friends in Little Howl.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_FortressVillager01_Dialogue1_Paragr: The Villager lets out a disappointed hrrm. They were hoping to find safety inside the fortress, but <emphasis>the doors are locked from the inside!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_Interact01_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Villager lights up with long-awaited hope when they see that a hero has come to Rainy Plains. The illagers are kidnapping villagers and <emphasis>performing weird soul-powered experiments in the towers.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA00_VillagerRescue_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Villager looks around in horror. Those nasty illagers appeared out of nowhere and burnt everything down!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_BridgeVillager01_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Villager looks longingly across the water. The other villagers fled to seek shelter in the abandoned fortress, but <emphasis>the bridge was destroyed.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_GateRescue_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Villager ran to get help when the <emphasis>illagers attacked Honeycomb Farm.</> Their friends are still in danger!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_CapturedVillager03_Dialogue1_Paragr: The Villager saw <emphasis>the Supreme Evoker heading to the top of the tower.</> They are on the verge of figuring out how to create life using only copper and soul power. Somebody has to stop them!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_B_BridgeVillagerBefore_Dialogue1_Pa: The Villager shakes their head. Nobody is allowed to cross the bridge without <emphasis>permission.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_B_BridgeVillager_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Villager stares intently at the <emphasis>broken bridge lever,</> maybe hoping that a good stare will magically fix it.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_BridgeVillager02_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Villager thanks you for helping them reach the fortress. There are more <emphasis>villagers hiding in the fishing huts</> who need help finding safety.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_ReturnToOasis_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Villager thanks you for rescuing their friends and <emphasis>thwarting the Illager High Council's reign over Rainy Plains.</> For the first time in a while, Puddle Pond has reason to celebrate!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_OasisWoodcutter_Dialogue1_Paragraph: The Woodcutter praises you for bringing peace to Puddle Pond and sending the Supreme Evoker running. But they haven't come here just to join the party...
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_Blacksmith01_Dialogue3_Paragraph1: The Woodcutter's Outpost lies ahead. Can you <emphasis>make sure the path is safe?</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_Caretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The creature whistles a little melody for greeting and introduces themselves as <emphasis>an echo golem.</> A caretaker of this dimension.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_AngryCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: The echo golems always gather up on <emphasis>Lullaby Hilltop</> to sing to the portal across the chasm. If you can <emphasis>escort it up there,</> the Golem can sing with its friends again.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_C_EnchantsmithTown_Dialogue1_Paragr: The enchantment books you rescued seem to be in good condition, apart from a few scuffs and dog-ears. <Emphasis>Savage illagers!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_B_SpiderCaveInteriorVillager_Dialog: The foragers promise to <emphasis>meet you outside</> and direct you to the real Deep Dark caves.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_CentralDeposit01_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The ichor core fits perfectly. There should be another at <emphasis>the top of the nearest illager tower.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: The ichor is pumped out through the portal <emphasis>to fuel some mad creation</> they are building on the other side. Somebody has to <emphasis>stop them before it's too late to heal the Sift!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_Caretaker04_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: The illagers are <emphasis>hiding out in a cave nearby,</> but what they don't know is that the cave is a sculker nest. The <emphasis>sculkers won't be happy</> to see the ichor corrupted like this.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_GateVillager_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The illagers are just on the other side of the gate! The Villager looks around for the key golem. It got so scared <emphasis>it flew away.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_B_Gate01_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The illagers definitely don't want any heroes to travel beyond Singer's Meadow. You'll have to lure them out.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: The illagers have discovered that the ichor is packed with soul power and they have been <emphasis>trying to harvest it to fuel their experiments.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_VistaCaretaker_Dialogue2_Paragraph2: The illagers know that <emphasis>no hero would ever steal a soul block</> from an echo golem, even if it were the only way forward.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_Caretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: The illagers, as you call them, seem to be searching for a way to harness the powers of the Sift. But only <emphasis>the Singer knows the true secrets of soul power.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: The illagers, united under the leadership of <emphasis>the Illager High Council,</> have launched a surprise attack across the Overworld.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_KeyGolem_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The key golem is not so scared now that a hero is here. It wants to catch a ride with you <emphasis>back to the gate!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_B_BridgeVillager_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The lever broke just before the Illager High Council attacked, almost as if they wanted to <emphasis>stop anyone from entering Howling Woods.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA03_TrappedCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The little Echo Golem whistles with relief and gratitude. Those mean <emphasis>illagers captured it and brought it back to this strange dimension</> that you call the Overworld.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_VistaCaretaker_Dialogue2_Paragraph4: The music swells with fiery determination as the Echo Golem offers you to <emphasis>take its soul block...</> its life force... and use it to <emphasis>save the world it loves so much.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA03_DeepDarkNote01_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The notebook is scrawled with ugly illager markings that almost resemble musical notes. Why would illagers be meddling with music?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_B_VillageMerchantFarm_Dialogue1_Par: The old minecart stations have been shut down for years, but once activated, you can <emphasis>get to Brave Haven</> faster than a creeper’s blink.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_Blacksmith01_Dialogue4_Paragraph2: The old smith eyes your items skeptically. That armor looks like it might bend in the wind, and your weapons seem as sharp as blades of grass.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_VistaCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: The only way to stop the illagers is to <emphasis>go through the portal and shut it down</> from the Overworld side.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_CaretakerHub_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: The other golems are hiding because the illagers have been <emphasis>capturing tuners and putting them in cages.</> They don't want anyone to <emphasis>travel further into the Sift.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_BossReplay_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The runes seem to hold some magic that could <emphasis>revive the Copper Monstrosity.</> Do you want to read the incantation aloud?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_BossReplay_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The runes seem to hold some magic that could <emphasis>revive the Monarch.</> Do you want to read the incantation aloud?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_BossReplay_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The runes seem to hold some magic that could <emphasis>revive the Prime Enchanter.</> Do you want to read the incantation aloud?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_BR_B_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The runes seem to hold some magic that could <emphasis>revive the Redstone Monstrosity.</> Do you want to read the incantation aloud?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_B_BossReplay_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The runes seem to hold some magic that could <emphasis>revive the Sculk Monstrosity.</> Do you want to read the incantation aloud?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_SoulConstructReplay_Dialogue1_Parag: The runes seem to hold some magic that could <emphasis>revive the Supreme Evoker and their Monstrous Opus.</> Do you want to read the incantation aloud?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA03_BossReplay_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The runes seem to hold some magic that could <emphasis>revive the Twisted Warden.</> Do you want to read the incantation aloud?
