Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_BossReplay_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The runes seem to hold some magic that could <emphasis>revive the Twisted Warden.</> Do you want to read the incantation aloud?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_BossReplay_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The runes seem to hold some magic that could <emphasis>revive the witch</> who used to live here. Do you want to read the incantation aloud?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA09_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph5: The sculkers are extremely territorial and like <emphasis>keeping the tuners around when they bathe</> in the ichor. If you want to <emphasis>pass the musical gate,</> you will have to disturb their bath time.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA00_VillagerDocks01_Dialogue1_Paragraph: The village is destroyed and <emphasis>Squid Coast is swarming with monsters.</> You all need to get out of here before it's too late.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA00_Villager01_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The villagers are trying to get to the boats and sail to safety, but there are too many monsters on the path! <emphasis>Can you clear the way?</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_ReturnToOasis_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: The villagers welcome you to <emphasis>stay and explore Rainy Plains</> before you go searching for the second note block.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_FortressVillager01_Dialogue1_Paragr: There are many <emphasis>secret passageways into the fortress,</> but the Villager only knows one of them, and it's dangerous to go through there.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA00_VillagerRescue_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: There are still illagers and monsters roaming the ruins. <emphasis>Rescue the stranded villagers</> and tell them to meet up at the village gate.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: There is <emphasis>an illager base in Rainy Plains</> where they may have taken the note blocks, but the path goes through the older parts of Howling Woods, where only the woodcutters know the way.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph4: There is a choir of golems that usually <emphasis>gather up on Lullaby Hilltop</> to sing. Find them and they can show you where the illager-controlled portal is.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA03_FreedCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: There should be <emphasis>a tunnel at the back of the cave</> that leads straight to Brave Haven... Maybe <emphasis>the Cartographer will have some ideas</> about where the illagers are taking the note blocks.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_BarnVillager_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: These monsters sound dangerous, but the chance to <emphasis>investigate a rift</> might be the key to stopping the illager invasion!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_BridgeVillager01_Dialogue2_Paragrap: These planks will make a fine bridge. <emphasis>The Villager will meet you at the abandoned fortress</> where the others were heading.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: They are traveling through strange rifts, and now their <emphasis>troops are gathering outside the town gates,</> preparing to attack!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: They came through the portal and have been installing <emphasis>giant pipes that are draining the land of ichor,</> the purified rivers of souls that flow through the dimension. This is why the Sift is ill.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_OldVillager_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: They confirm that <emphasis>the Illager High Council has been lurking around the Deep Dark caves</> for some time. The Enchantsmith saw them down there.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA07_OverlookVillager_Dialogue1_Paragrap: They have also crafted <emphasis>these strange blocks that control all the bridges and towers.</> The cores are powered by some strange fuel from the new dimension that the illagers call... ichor.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_CapturedCaretaker01_Dialogue1_Parag: They have sent <emphasis>a troop of illagers to attack and capture the Singer</> so that the Sift will fall to the Illager High Council.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_BarnVillager_Dialogue3_Paragraph2: They invite you to stay and explore Honeycomb Fields. <emphasis>There are others who could use a hero's helping hand.</> Speak with the Farmer again when you are ready to track down the Illager High Council.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA01_B_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: They nod their head in the direction that the Merchant went. If you hurry you may still catch up with them by <emphasis>the bridge into Howling Woods.</>"
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_C_EnchantsmithTown_Dialogue2_Paragr: They promise to help <Emphasis>enchant your items</> whenever you need it.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA08_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph4: They urge you to <emphasis>check on the golems</> and see why their songs have gone silent.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA06_FortressVillager01_Dialogue1_Paragr: They welcome you to <emphasis>stay and explore the Frozen Highlands</> for as long as you wish. There are villagers who could use help from a hero.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_C_EnchantsmithOutpostReturn_Dialogu: They will now <emphasis>catch a minecart back to Brave Haven</> to analyze these books and invite you to <Emphasis>visit their stall</> as soon as possible.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_C_EmptyLectern_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: This is where the evoker was keeping the last enchantment book, but they seem to have escaped. <Emphasis>The Enchantsmith won't be happy</> that they got away.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA06_FortressVillager01_Dialogue1_Paragr: When you're ready to leave, you should <emphasis>bring the two note blocks to the Cartographer in Brave Haven.</> They will know what to do next.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA03_FreedCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph4: With a lonesome whistle, the Echo Golem vows to search the caves until you return. The illagers have brought many golems to the Overworld, and some may be lost down here.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA10_SoulConstruct_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: With an army of these, the Overworld won’t stand a chance. <emphasis>Who would create such a nightmare?</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA04_Blacksmith01_Dialogue4_Paragraph3: With the axes delivered, the Blacksmith gets ready to catch a minecart <emphasis>back to Brave Haven</> and insists that you <emphasis>follow them to their stall</> before you go any further.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_CartographerQuestgiver_Dialogue1_Pa: With the new bridge lever you can <emphasis>cross the bridge</> into Howling Woods. <emphasis>Find Little Howl Hamlet.</> The villagers there can direct you towards the caves.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA03_FreedCaretaker_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: Without them, the machine can't play the right keys to unlock the portal, and the Echo Golem will be stuck in this dimension forever. It hopes that you can <emphasis>help it return home.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA05_OasisWoodcutter_Dialogue1_Paragraph: Word of your deeds has already spread to <emphasis>Woodcutter's Outpost</> and <emphasis>a villager there is asking for your help.</> There is something terrible happening in the Frozen Highlands!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_OldVillager_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: You are welcome to stay and rest in Little Howl, but if you mean to track the illagers, you should <emphasis>find the Enchantsmith near the minecart station.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Core.cs.CA02_B_SpiderCaveInteriorVillager_Dialog: You arrived in the nick of time! The illagers were on their way to the Deep Dark but discovered that <emphasis>they had entered the wrong cave.</>

Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.CT_S02_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: <emphasis>The Echo Golem wakes up</> with a chirp, and then starts shivering from the freezing cold. They don't have tides this cold in the Sift.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S13_A_MainHallVillager_Dialogue1_Pa: <emphasis>The door at the back of this hall</> leads through the passageway. Can you <emphasis>intercept the illagers</> before they make their attack?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S12_A_EndBannerInteract_Dialogue1_P: A low rumble is heard from underground... Are you sure it was a good idea to <emphasis>read the runes out loud?</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.CT_S02_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragraph2: After getting careful directions <emphasis>to the portal in the Deep Dark,</> the Echo Golem hurries off through the weird, white mush.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S13_A_RunningVillager_Dialogue1_Par: Can you <emphasis>rescue the captured miners and stop the illagers</> before they sneak into the fortress and ambush everyone taking refuge there?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S12_A_ThirdBook_Dialogue1_Paragraph: It is a dictionary translating one of the three runes from the ruins. The rune is used to wake something from slumber. So... <emphasis>Good morning?</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S12_A_SecondBook_Dialogue1_Paragrap: It is a manuscript decoding one of the three runes from the ruins. The rune literally translates to monster, beast, or... <emphasis>Monstrosity.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S14_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: It looks like the <emphasis>illagers have set up their new base</> in the ice caves. If the fishers don't have their fishing equipment, the villagers won't be able to survive in the fortress for long.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S13_A_MainHallVillager_Dialogue1_Pa: Just before you showed up, they heard the illagers saying that <emphasis>they had found one of the secret passageways into the fortress</> and were already gathering their troops to sneak inside!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S12_A_DroppedPage_Dialogue1_Paragra: One of the illagers dropped a page ripped from a book about illager runes. It must be from <emphasis>the library towers.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S14_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragrap: The Fisher is relieved to have their fishing gear back. Now <emphasis>they will be able to feed the whole fortress</> until this invasion is over.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S14_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Fisher is starving. They left their <emphasis>fishing equipment in the ice caves,</> and when they came to collect it there was an illager gate in the way.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S12_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Librarian asks you to go <emphasis>search Archie's ruins</> just outside of the fortress to find out what the illagers are doing there.
The Librarian was sneaking into the library towers where the illagers are still holed up, just looking for some decent lavatory reading.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S13_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Miner just ran for their life and needs to catch their breath. They escaped from some nasty <emphasis>illagers who were forcing them to dig a tunnel.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S13_A_RunningVillager_Dialogue1_Par: The Miner thanks you for chasing off the illagers. But many of their friends are still being forced to dig up on the mountainside. <emphasis>The illagers are trying to dig their way into the fortress!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S13_A_EndQuest_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Miner thanks you for stopping the illagers sneaking into the fortress. Now they can finally feel safe in their new home.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S12_A_FirstBook_Dialogue1_Paragraph: The book describes one of the three runes from the ruins. It literally translates to <emphasis>sculk...</> Very strange.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S13_A_MainHallVillager_Dialogue1_Pa: The miners are grateful to be free of the illagers, but <emphasis>they are still worried</> that the illagers will come for them.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.CT_S02_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The poor Echo Golem has been left to freeze like a Sift popsicle. If you can <emphasis>find its stolen soul block,</> it may defrost.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S12_A_FirstBannerInteract_Dialogue1: There are three illager runes on the wall. <emphasis>What do they mean?</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S14_A_IceCaveGateInteract_Dialogue1: There's an illager note nailed to the gate. The illager guards remind their friends that in case they get locked out, <emphasis>there is a spare key stashed away in the broken shipwreck.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S13_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: They managed to shake the illagers off but... looks like <emphasis>they are catching up already!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_DesertA.DEa1_S12_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: They overheard a group of illagers doing research. It sounded like they were <emphasis>working on something in the old ruins</> where the Arch-Illager once used to conduct experiments.

Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S10_Cleric_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: <emphasis>The Apprentice already cooked up a cure</> with those blue spider eyes, and the Cleric has to admit it looks to have done the trick. Now they have plenty to keep the village healthy.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.CT_S01_Caretaker01_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: <emphasis>The Echo Golem whirrs to life</> but quickly looks around at the scary forest and starts trembling. It has never seen plants like these before!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S08_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: But everyone knows that wolves will only follow someone they respect. The Wolf Tamer <emphasis>sends their pet wolf to pick up the scent</> of its missing pack.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S10_Cleric_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: Can you go <emphasis>look near the Spider Caves</> and make sure that silly apprentice hasn't gotten into trouble?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S10_Apprentice_Dialogue2_Paragraph2: If you can <emphasis>find the satchel and bring it back to Little Howl,</> the Apprentice thinks they can make a cure for the sick villagers in no time.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.CT_S01_Caretaker01_Dialogue2_Paragraph2: It cannot wait to get home to the familiar dangers in the Sift, and after getting careful directions <emphasis>to the portal in the Deep Dark,</> the Echo Golem hurries off.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.CT_S01_Caretaker01_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: It is one of the kidnapped echo golems, but it's missing its soul block. <emphasis>The illagers who did this can't have gone far.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S10_Cleric_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: On top of it all, <emphasis>the Cleric's apprentice</> had some crazy idea about how to cure the sickness and <emphasis>ran out to gather spider eyes.</> Now they are missing. Typical.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S10_Apprentice_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: The Apprentice came looking for soul corrupted spider eyes when dozens of them appeared in the dark! <emphasis>They lost their satchel</> somewhere in the cave.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S10_Cleric_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Cleric is worried about the <emphasis>sick villagers.</> They have been eating plants that grew near the sculk, and now nothing seems to make them happy.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S10_Apprentice_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Cleric's Apprentice shakes their head in terror. <emphasis>More spiders are coming!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S08_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Wolf Tamer is growling and snarling with anger. <emphasis>A band of illager poachers has been hunting down the wolves</> of the forest. They think that all animals can be tamed with force...
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S08_FollowWolf_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The wolf barks at the water. The poachers must be on <emphasis>the other side of the river.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S08_FollowWolf_Dialogue3_Paragraph1: The wolf howls with respect and gratitude for <emphasis>rescuing their pack.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S08_FollowWolf_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: The wolf wants you to take a <emphasis>look in the secret cellar down the old wishing well.</> You quietly wish there were more wolf poachers to beat up down there.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S08_FollowWolf_Dialogue4_Paragraph1: The wolf yips anxiously, begging you to <emphasis>follow.</> It wants to show you something else.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_ForestA.S10_Satchel_DIalogue1_Paragraph1: This must be <emphasis>the Apprentice's missing satchel.</> It is filled to the brim with blue-glowing spider eyes.

Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S05_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: <emphasis>Head into the wild meadows</> and see if you can do something about the illager infestation so the sifters can have peace in their nests again.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S06_A_Caretaker_Dialogue3_Paragraph: All the wobbles are in safety again except for one. The last wobble got so scared it bounced off <emphasis>past the musical gate</>, into the meadows beyond.
Another golem went to search for it, but <emphasis>now both of them are missing.</> And there is something dangerous out there... <emphasis>sculkers!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S05_A_RescuedCaretaker01_Dialogue1_: If you can <emphasis>rip out the illager invasion by the roots of these strange trees,</> the Golem thinks the sifters might calm down a little.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S06_A_LostCaretaker_Dialogue3_Parag: It used to be scared of just about everything. But after seeing your bravery, <emphasis>it wants to follow you on your journey</> and help save the Sift.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S06_A_QuestStart_Dialogue1_Paragrap: One of the wobbles is hiding in some bushes nearby. <emphasis>Can you find it</> before it gets into trouble?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S06_A_LostCaretaker_Dialogue3_Parag: The <emphasis>illagers are really disrupting the natural order</>, driving the sculkers this far from their territory. Even <emphasis>this wobble has changed.</>
The Echo Golem breathes a sigh of relief. If it weren’t for the brave wobble defending it, the Golem would be shards at the bottom of the ravines by now.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S06_A_QuestStart_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Echo Golem lets out a frantic chirp as you approach. Thank the Singer you are here! The Golem was looking after some wobbles but <emphasis>they all got scared by the illagers and bounced off.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S05_A_RescuedCaretaker01_Dialogue1_: The Echo Golem lets out a hopeless chirp. The sifters are usually peaceful creatures, but the <emphasis>illagers have been planting strange trees all around the wild meadows.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S06_A_QuestGiber_Dialogue2_Paragrap: The Golem thanks you for returning the wobble, but <emphasis>the others are still missing.</> The wobbles are helpless creatures, they aren't safe on their own.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S06_A_Caretaker_Dialogue3_Paragraph: The Sift has a natural order to things. Sculkers belong in the ravines, wobbles belong in the meadows. If <emphasis>sculkers are hunting this far from their own territory,</> things really aren’t right.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S05_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Singer sings another of their ethereal songs, and the Echo Golem joins in, harmonizing in a more familiar key. They are worried about <emphasis>the sifters that roam the wild meadows nearby.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S05_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragrap: The Singer’s song ripples with anger and grief over what the illager presence is doing to the sifters. <emphasis>Are these once peaceful creatures lost to their rage forever?</>
The song ends on a hopeful note, imagining a day when the illagers are chased out of this dimension... and <emphasis>the Sift will have peace again.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S05_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: Their protective and peaceful nature has been twisted into something violent, as if <emphasis>they have been driven mad by the presence of the invasive illagers.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa1_S05_A_RescuedCaretaker01_Dialogue1_: These trees only have one big scary leaf and they don't grow at all!

Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa2_S02_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: But if you listen carefully, you can hear faint notes ringing in the air. <emphasis>A soul block is reaching out</> across the Sift, calling for you. <emphasis>Can you find it?</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa2_S02_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragrap: But the Golem can sense that the illagers are hurting the Sift again, activating strange machines around Lullaby Hills. Can you <emphasis>deactivate the illager machines?</>
It sings a song of endless gratitude that you destroyed the portal and even returned to give it a new soul block.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa2_S02_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: It's <emphasis>your friend who sacrificed its soul block</> so you could reach the portal. Its song forever silenced...
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa2_S03_A_QuestStart_Dialogue1_Paragrap: Now the echo golems don't sing anymore. Although, sometimes when the wind is just right, the Golem can still hear <emphasis>the song of the soul blocks echoing across the chasm.</>
The Echo Golem hums solemnly. It doesn't want to seem ungrateful after all you have done, but <emphasis>Lullaby Hills is very lonely</> these days.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa2_S02_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue3_Paragrap: The Scared Golem is relieved to hear that <emphasis>you deactivated the strange illager machines.</> Let's hope you won't see more of those scary things.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa2_S02_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragrap: The Scared Golem wakes with a shriek! Oh, it's just you...
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa2_S03_A_QuestStart_Dialogue2_Paragrap: The echo golems are finally singing together again. Now they can start to <emphasis>bring harmony back to Lullaby Hills.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_MeadowA.MEa2_S03_A_QuestStart_Dialogue1_Paragrap: Then, <emphasis>the illagers stole the soul blocks</> from the echo golems and took them to their stronghold on the other side of the chasm.
These meadows once flourished with souls and music, with <emphasis>all the echo golems singing together</> as they cared for the Sift.

Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Misc.cs.GimmicksTest_S02_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: Completing this quest will make the light turn blue!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Misc.cs.GimmicksTest_S01_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: Furthermore, we may see setups we hate (boulders in water?) and determine new rules/restrictions LD should apply when implementing gimmicks
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Misc.cs.GimmicksTest_S02_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: Talk to the villager next to me to complete the quest!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Misc.cs.GimmicksTest_S01_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: The goal here is to experiment with complex gimmick setups and discover bugs/missing functionality LD may want
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Misc.cs.DevTestNPC_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: This quest is for testing purposes.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Misc.cs.GimmicksTest_S01_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: Welcome to the Gimmick Trial Gym! This is an area used to stress test gimmicks in game-accurate environments
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Misc.cs.GimmicksTest_S02_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: YOOOO you completed the quest bro!

Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Candlemaker01_S08_A_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: <emphasis>The illagers plan to blow up the food storage.</> If they do, all the villagers in Honeycomb Fields will go hungry!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.CT_S03_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragraph2: After getting careful directions <emphasis>back to the portal in the Deep Dark,</> the Echo Golem takes off in a hurry, sneezing as they go.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Farmer01_S08_A_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: Can you <emphasis>go to the Candlemaker's den</> and make sure they are okay?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Candlemaker01_S08_A_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: It's an illager map showing all the places where they plan to set Creeper Candles. You have to <emphasis>blow out the candles</> before they blow Honeycomb Fields away!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.CT_S03_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: It's one of the captured echo golems, broken and tossed away like trash. <emphasis>The illagers responsible for this might still be nearby.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Beekeeper_S04_A_Dialogue3_Paragraph1: The Beekeeper is buzzing to see that <emphasis>you built new beehives.</> The bees will be snuggling up in their cushy new hives until the sculk patches have been cleared away.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Beekeeper_S04_A_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: The Beekeeper is pleased with the planks. But the bees are a stingy bunch when it comes to their living arrangements. Make sure you <emphasis>find the perfect spot</> to move your striped friends.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Beekeeper_S04_A_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Beekeeper seems concerned. Weird patches of <emphasis>sculk have spread from the illager rifts</> and are poisoning the flowers near the beehives.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Farmer01_S08_A_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: The Candlemaker had recently crafted <emphasis>a powerful new type of candle</> but worried that someone was spying on them, planning to steal it.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Candlemaker01_S08_A_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Candlemaker is all fired up! They had just finished crafting a batch of their new <emphasis>explosive Creeper Candles</> when illagers attacked and stole them.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Candlemaker01_S08_A_Dialogue3_Paragraph1: The Candlemaker lights up when they hear you stopped the illager plot. Those <emphasis>Creeper Candles should only be in the hands of heroes</> who know how to use them responsibly.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.CT_S03_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: The Echo Golem jolts alive and immediately lets out <emphasis>a whistling sneeze.</> The weird flowers of this dimension are making it itch all over!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Farmer01_S08_A_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Farmer looks around for their friend, the Candlemaker. They have been waiting all day, but <emphasis>their friend is nowhere to be seen.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Location_S04_A_Dialogue3_Paragraph1: The bees deserve a hive with a view. This simply won't do. <emphasis>Onwards!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Location_S04_A_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: The bees won't be pleased with all these monsters running around. Let's <emphasis>look elsewhere.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Candlemaker01_S08_A_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: There should be <emphasis>a key to the food cellar in the Candlemaker's workshop</> but the illagers are still up there looking for more Creeper Candles.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Location_S04_A_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: This spot is still too close to the sculk. <emphasis>Keep searching!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Location_S04_A_Dialogue4_Paragraph1: This will be a great location for the <emphasis>new beehives!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.Beekeeper_S04_A_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: Unless you can <emphasis>collect some wooden planks</> and find a good spot to <emphasis>build new beehives</>, the sweet bees may get sick from the sculk!

Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.CT_S04_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragraph1: <emphasis>The Echo Golem opens its eyes</> with effort. It tries to move its arms but the joints have gone all rusty in the humidity. Echo golems aren't built for this weather.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S15_A_CopperBarrel01_Dialogue1_Para: <emphasis>The barrel is empty.</> It's a decoy! The real convoy must have taken another route.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.CT_S04_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: All this humidity can't be good for the poor Echo Golem. It's gonna start rusting unless <emphasis>the stolen soul block is returned!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S15_A_CopperBarrel02_Dialogue1_Para: But they can’t be far away now...
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S15_A_CopperBarrel03_Dialogue1_Para: Finally, you found the copper! Let's <emphasis>get this to the Inventor</> and maybe he can put it to better use.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S15_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: If they get the copper back to the High Council, they might create a new Monstrosity! Can you <emphasis>intercept the illagers</> before they get away with the copper?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S15_A_CopperBarrel02_Dialogue1_Para: Oof! <emphasis>Filled with ravager manure.</> These Illagers are mocking you!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S17_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: Rumors say that now, with no monsters or villagers to use as test subjects, <emphasis>the illagers have started experimenting on themselves...</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S16_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragrap: The <emphasis>Gatherer is too scared to go picking flowers.</> Those scary ravagers eat all the lilies, trample the roses and leave behind a mess of mud and manure.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S16_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue4_Paragrap: The Gatherer <emphasis>gasps with delight</> at the pretty flowers you picked.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S16_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue3_Paragrap: The Gatherer beams at the pretty flowers you picked. If you can <emphasis>carry them back to Puddle Pond</> with all the petals in place, the Gatherer promises a reward.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S16_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragrap: The Gatherer wonders if you can help <emphasis>pick some pretty flowers</> from the places where the ravagers roam?
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.CT_S04_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragraph2: The Golem can't wait to sink into a nice, long ichor bath and begins to waddle <emphasis>towards the portal in the Deep Dark,</> creaking and squeaking as it goes.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S15_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Inventor is grateful that you thwarted the Supreme Evoker’s schemes. But they can see some <emphasis>illagers scavenging copper from the Monstrosity</> you defeated.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S15_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragrap: The Inventor managed to recycle the copper and asked a blacksmith to forge you <emphasis>a weapon of a brand new design.</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S17_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragrap: The Villager is relieved that you saved Rainy Plains again. Let’s hope <emphasis>this puts an end to those horrific experiments</> once and for all.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S17_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Villager is thankful that you rescued them from the experiments. But a group of illagers have already <emphasis>moved back into the Red Tower</> and are continuing the Supreme Evoker’s work!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S16_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Villager looks around worriedly. <emphasis>The Gatherer went out to pick pretty flowers near the Red Tower,</> even though herds of ruthless ravagers roam nearby.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S17_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: The Villager looks around worriedly. One of their friends went to <emphasis>investigate the rumors,</> but they haven’t returned.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S17_A_InteractCage_Dialogue1_Paragr: The Villager snuck in to investigate a strange glow and saw the <emphasis>illagers experimenting with souls on themselves!</>
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S16_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragrap: They hope you can go see if the Gatherer has just stopped to smell the roses... or if they're already pushing daisies.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S16_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue4_Paragrap: They quickly arrange them into a beautiful bouquet and offer it to <emphasis>their very own wildflower warrior,</> along with a heart-shaped talisman to symbolize their undying friendship.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S17_A_InteractCage_Dialogue1_Paragr: Two troops of illagers with soul corrupted captains already left to <emphasis>take back the Orange Tower and the White Tower.</> You have to <emphasis>stop them</> or Rainy Plains will fall back under illager control!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_PlainsA.PLa2_S15_A_QuestGiver_Dialogue2_Paragrap: Wield it with pride as you go after the Illager High Council.

Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Town.cs.S02_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: As you peer down into the hole you hear a faint but urgent “HRM!” From what you can make out it looks like there’s a villager stuck down the hole.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Town.cs.S03_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph3: The Caretaker next to them beckons the Blacksmith to follow them, looks like they might know a way to get back home!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Town.cs.S02_Enchantsmith_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The Villager celebrates their freedom! They explain that they were searching for some Echo Shards when they tripped and fell into this pit.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Town.cs.S03_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph4: The old Blacksmith begins to slowly follow the Caretaker and tells you to come visit their shop next time you’re in the Town!
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Town.cs.S03_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: The old Blacksmith decides that they have been sitting around for too long and they need to get back to their shop.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Town.cs.S03_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: The old blacksmith looks confused, they explain they were minding their own business when a big glowing light appeared in front of them, next thing they can remember they were here.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Town.cs.S02_Enchantsmith_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: They thank you for saving them and offer you help with any items you might need enchanted, just swing by their stall next time you’re in the Town.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Town.cs.DevTestNPC_Dialogue1_Paragraph1: This quest is for testing purposes.
Text/Release/QuestDialogueLabels_Town.cs.S02_QuestGiver_Dialogue1_Paragraph2: You reach down to lend them a hand and pull them up to the surface.

Text/Release/SettingsLabels.csv.CloudSave_Description:
When Cloud Save is ON, your offline heroes' progress is synced with the cloud. 
In the event of a conflict, the system will select the appropriate save across devices and sessions. 

Turn this OFF to prevent any automatic cloud selection or syncing.
This can avoid unintended overwrites or conflicts when multiple devices use the same character at the same time or when you haven’t had a chance to sync. 

With this setting OFF, the game will only store your offline heroes locally and you will not be able to access progress from other devices.

Note: this will only impact offline heroes, online heroes will always be synced to the cloud.
